class.name: TrenchBroomGameConfigExporter
class.brief_description: Exports the current project's native TrenchBroom game configuration.
class.description: Editor-only helper used by the TrenchBroom dock and editor automation. Reads the project's TrenchBroom settings and generates a game configuration, FGD, and copied texture catalog in a dedicated project subdirectory. It does not launch TrenchBroom, generate Godot materials, or import maps.

method.name: export_game_config
method.description: Exports beneath the absolute filesystem [param parent_directory], usually TrenchBroom's user games directory. Returns [code]success[/code] and [code]message[/code], plus [code]directory[/code] on success. TrenchBroom's Game Path must be set to that generated directory. Validates and stages files before replacing an existing export. Directories without this project's ownership marker are not replaced. Generated directories must not contain hand-authored files, as re-export replaces their contents. Failed validation leaves the previous export intact.

method.name: get_export_directory
method.description: Returns the project's export directory beneath [param parent_directory], or an empty string if the parent is not an absolute filesystem path. The directory name combines the game name with a hash of the project path. Does not create or modify files.
